sample_unit: clinic notes (50 UCSF test, 250 Stanford external validation)

links.outcome: Performance across sites (UCSF vs Stanford) for tNLP versus LLM extraction
links.effect: On Stanford external validation (n=250), tNLP models failed to generalize (61-62% accuracy) while GPT-4 maintained accuracies >90%.
links.quote: On external validation at Stanford (n=250), tNLP models failed to generalize (61-62% accuracy) while GPT-4 maintained accuracies >90%.

links.outcome: Model performance differences across demographic and diagnosis subgroups (fairness assessment)
links.effect: No biases were detected based on demographics or diagnosis.
links.quote: No biases were detected based on demographics or diagnosis.

screen.reason: The study retrospectively evaluates and compares LLMs and traditional NLP for extracting patient-reported outcomes from clinical notes, including an external validation and fairness assessment, but does not test a deployment practice or safeguard.
